The '''Queen Of Sauce Cookbook''' is a skill [[Books|book]] that can be purchased from the [[Bookseller]] for {{Price|50000}} after 100 [[Golden Walnut]]s have been collected.

Upon reading the book, players will learn all [[Cooking#Recipes|cooking recipes]] that could otherwise be learned from [[The Queen of Sauce]] [[Television|TV]] channel. This includes recipes that have not yet been aired. Subsequent readings do not give any effects or additional [[Skills|XP]].<ref name="qosbook" />

==Bundles==
Queen Of Sauce Cookbook is not used in any [[bundles]].

==Tailoring==
Queen Of Sauce Cookbook is not used in any [[tailoring]]. It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a blue dye at the dye pots located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]]. It can also be used as a blue dye when used in the spool of the [[Sewing Machine]] with a dyeable clothing item in the feed.

==Quests==
Queen Of Sauce Cookbook is not used in any [[quests]].
